_comment: Replace sheet/cell references with the calculator's real input and output cells. Inputs: numbers, text, booleans or null. Pick text values from the dropdown source lists so Excel would accept them. Expectation forms: value+tol, same_as, equals_product_of, is_error.

scenarios.name: T1 single material
scenarios.description: 1,000 kg of one material with a known A1-A3 factor; checks row result, block sum, module total and summary pick-up.

scenarios.name: T3 transport A4
scenarios.description: Known mass, distance and vehicle; A4 should equal mass x km x factor in consistent units (watch kg vs t).

scenarios.name: T7 missing emission factor
scenarios.description: Material/country combination with no record: warning, fallback, or silent zero?

scenarios.name: T8 invalid values
scenarios.description: Negative quantity and an unlisted unit text.

scenarios.name: T2b last block row reaches every total
scenarios.description: Quantity in the last row of the last block: every module total and summary should move.
